items.stem: 자연스러운 대화가 되도록 <보기>의 ⓐ~ⓓ를 올바르게 배열한 것은?

lines: B: Emma, what are you doing?
G: I'm making a travel plan for Jeju-do.
< 보 기 >
ⓐ I agree with you. So, what are you planning to do in Jeju-do?
ⓑ That sounds fun! Do you like to travel with plans?
ⓒ Yes, I do. I can save time and energy with plans.
ⓓ I'm planning to eat dombegogi and climb Hallasan.

items.explain: 계획 여행을 좋아하는지 묻기(ⓑ) → 그렇다(ⓒ) → 동의하고 계획 묻기(ⓐ) → 계획(ⓓ).

box.title: < 보 기 >
lines: ㄱ. He heard the dog crying in the rain.
ㄴ. My mom wants me clean my room.
ㄷ. The teacher told us to open our books.
ㄹ. I saw him to enter the classroom.
ㅁ. The teacher advised us not to rush.
ㅂ. Did you see she carrying the box by herself?

choices: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅂ
ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ
ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ, ㅂ
items.explain: ㄴ wants me to clean, ㄹ saw him entering[enter], ㅂ she → her(목적어는 목적격).

items.box:
B: Yumi, do you like sports?
G: Sure. I love sports a lot.
B: Which do you prefer, team sports or individual sports?
G: __________(A)__________ I like to work together as a team to reach our goals.
B: Yeah, I know you're working so hard with your soccer team.
G: Right. I love my team. How about you?
B: I prefer individual sports like swimming or running. I like to focus on myself when I exercise.
choices: I prefer individual sports to team sports.
I don't like sports at all.
I prefer team sports to individual sports.
I'm not good at swimming or running.
I don't agree with you. Team sports are boring.
items.explain: 팀으로 함께 일하는 것을 좋아한다고 이어지므로 팀 스포츠를 더 좋아한다는 말.

choices: Sharing something online is easy, but removing it is hard.
I'm not good at math, so I prefer English to math.
She was so weak that she ran faster than anyone.
He was embarrassed because his mistake was seen by everyone.
Don't click on links from unknown sources. It can be dangerous.
items.explain: 너무 약해서 누구보다 빨리 달렸다는 것은 앞뒤가 맞지 않는다.
items.source: L6 본문 · L5 대화 · 학습지 Words

items.box: Hi, I'm Jihun. Last month, I saw an interesting advertisement online. It said that I could get a new smartphone for free. I clicked on it without thinking much. Then, I filled out my information to receive the gift. However, instead of getting a new smartphone, I have received useless emails and phone calls from unknown numbers. Oh, my! I just ⓐ<u>heard my phone ringing</u> again. It makes me very upset. I'm sure that someone is using my information in a bad way. I think that my personal information was shared. I want to delete it. Can you help me, please?

choices: He saw an advertisement online last month.
He clicked on the advertisement without thinking much.
He filled out his information to receive a gift.
He got a new smartphone for free.
He thinks his personal information was shared.
items.explain: 새 스마트폰 대신 쓸모없는 이메일과 전화를 받았다.

items.stem: <보기>에서 윗글의 ⓐ와 문법적으로 성격이 같은 것<u>만</u>으로 짝지어진 것은?

box.title: < 보 기 >
lines: ㄱ. I <u>watched her opening</u> the box.
ㄴ. He <u>enjoys taking</u> pictures.
ㄷ. We <u>saw the bird flying</u> in the sky.
ㄹ. <u>Making</u> cheese salad is very easy.
ㅁ. He <u>felt his hands shaking</u>.
ㅂ. She <u>is making</u> a travel plan for Jeju-do.

choices: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅂ
ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ
ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ, ㅂ
items.explain: ⓐ는 「지각동사+목적어+현재분사」. ㄴ·ㄹ은 동명사(목적어·주어), ㅂ은 현재진행형.

items.box:
Reporter: Hello, Ms. Ali. Can you tell me why you became a sports journalist?
Ms. Ali: Well, I've always had a passion for sports and writing. Writing about sports makes me excited.
Reporter: There was a big baseball game yesterday. How did you spend the day?
Ms. Ali: I arrived at the baseball park early. ___ⓐ___ the game started, I had an interview with the players. I took a lot of notes ___ⓑ___ the game. ___ⓒ___ the game, I went to the press conference with other journalists. I asked the players how they felt about the game. In the afternoon, I had to write an article and edit it very quickly. My article was posted online. I love writing about sports.

choices: Ms. Ali became a sports journalist because her family loved baseball.
Ms. Ali arrived at the baseball park late.
Ms. Ali took a lot of notes during the game.
Ms. Ali went to the press conference alone.
Ms. Ali's article was printed in a newspaper.
items.explain: 경기 중에 메모를 많이 했다. 스포츠와 글쓰기에 대한 열정 때문에 기자가 되었고, 일찍 도착했으며, 다른 기자들과 회견에 갔고, 기사는 온라인에 게시되었다.
경기가 시작되기 전(Before) 인터뷰 / 경기 중(during+명사) 메모 / 경기 후(After) 기자 회견. while 뒤에는 절이 온다.

choices: Music can make you happily.
She wonders who are they.
Please keep fresh the milk.
This fan keeps the room cool.
I found the weather perfection.
items.explain: ④ 「keep+목적어+형용사」. ① happy ② who they are ③ keep the milk fresh ⑤ perfect.

items.box: Hi, I'm Bella. Last Friday, I ___ⓐ___ after school. He was playing really well, so I took a picture of him. Then I shared it on my social media. Over the weekend, something went wrong. Someone made a copy of the picture with bad comments. The copy was spread here and there, and I was so embarrassed. My brother ___ⓑ___ the picture of him. I apologized to him, and I deleted my post immediately. However, the copies still remain online. I want to remove them all. Please help me.

choices: When did Bella see her brother playing basketball?
Why did Bella take a picture of her brother?
Who made a copy of the picture with bad comments?
What did Bella do after her brother asked her to delete the picture?
Where do the copies of the picture still remain?
items.explain: 복사본을 만든 사람은 '누군가(someone)'로만 나온다.

rows: saw my brother to play basketball

items.explain: 「see+목적어+-ing」 / 「want+목적어+to부정사」.
items.source: L6 본문 Bella · 통합본 L6 문법

items.box: Hello. Today, I'll introduce a special app, MuzSearch. When you want to know the ___ⓐ___ of a song, this app will help you. It's simple to use. First, open the MuzSearch app and touch the search icon. Second, press the ___ⓑ___ icon and wait for a while. Then the app will show the title on the screen. If you like the song, don't forget to press the heart icon. The song will be ___ⓒ___ to your favorites. Try it now!

choices: MuzSearch is an app for decorating photos.
You should press the heart icon first to search for a song.
The app shows the title of the song on the screen.
You have to wait for a day after pressing the icon.
The app cannot save songs to your favorites.
items.explain: 앱이 화면에 노래 제목을 보여 준다. 하트 아이콘은 노래가 마음에 들 때 누르며, 잠시만 기다리면 되고, 즐겨찾기에 저장된다.
노래 제목(title)을 알고 싶을 때 / 마이크(microphone) 아이콘을 누르고 기다림 / 즐겨찾기에 저장(saved).
items.source: L6 Enjoy the Clip A · 어휘

items.box: I am a P.E. teacher. I love sports and teaching them. This morning, I taught basketball to the 2nd-year students. In the next class, I taught badminton to the 3rd-year students. The lessons went really well. I planned for next week's classes and wrote lesson plans in the afternoon. My job is perfect for me ___ⓐ___ I enjoy teaching many different kinds of sports to my students.

choices: How to Play Badminton Well
A Day of a P.E. Teacher
The Best Sports for Students
Why Students Love Basketball
Rules for Writing Lesson Plans
items.explain: 체육 교사의 하루 일과와 직업 만족을 소개하는 글.

choices: but
because
although
so
if
items.explain: 직업이 완벽한 이유(다양한 스포츠를 가르치는 것을 즐기기 때문)를 잇는 because.

box.title: < 보 기 >
lines: ⓐ to say you are sorry for something you did wrong
ⓑ to remove something, such as a file or message, from a computer or phone
ⓒ information about you that is left online by your activities
ⓓ the place where something comes from or starts
ⓔ feeling shy, uncomfortable, or ashamed because of a mistake

choices: I want to (   ) to him for my mistake.
You can (   ) the message from your phone.
Are you worried about your digital (   )?
Don't click on links from unknown (   )s.
Someone made a copy of the picture with bad (   )s.
items.explain: ⑤에는 comment(댓글)가 들어간다. ① apologize ② delete ③ footprint ④ source.

items.stem: 자연스러운 대화가 되도록 <보기>의 ⓐ~ⓓ를 올바르게 배열한 것은?

lines: A: Jiho, let's decide what to cook for dinner.
B: Okay. Do you have anything in mind?
< 보 기 >
ⓐ Italian food? But cooking Italian food is difficult.
ⓑ I prefer Italian food to Korean food.
ⓒ I don't agree with you. It's not that hard. Pizza and spaghetti are easy to make.
ⓓ Hmm, which do you prefer, Italian food or Korean food?
A: Great! Then let's make them. I'll help you!

items.explain: 선호 묻기(ⓓ) → 이탈리아 음식(ⓑ) → 어렵다는 반응(ⓐ) → 반박(ⓒ).

items.box:
Reporter: I want to know why you wanted to be a sports statistician, Ms. Lee.
Ms. Lee: I wanted to be a sports statistician because I liked ⓐ<u>to analyze</u> sports with numbers. Above all, I love ice hockey.
Reporter: I don't know much about a sports statistician. Can you explain ⓑ<u>it</u> to me?
Ms. Lee: A sports statistician is someone who collects data and ⓒ<u>study</u> numbers about sports games. (A) Our team is going to play against the Ice Lions this Saturday. (B) Last week, I carefully watched the Ice Lions' games and analyzed their shots. (C) I found that they let in 70 percent of the shots from the left side. (D) Then, I shared this finding ⓓ<u>with</u> our players. (E) I'm happy to use my data ⓔ<u>to help</u> our team.

items.explain: 관계대명사 who의 선행사가 someone(단수)이므로 collects and studies. ⓐ like to+동사원형, ⓓ share A with B, ⓔ 목적을 나타내는 to부정사.

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 <보기>에 주어진 문장의 위치로 가장 적절한 곳은?

box.title: < 보 기 >
lines: This showed their left side was weak.

items.explain: 왼쪽에서 70퍼센트의 슛을 허용했다는 발견(This) 다음, 그 결과(this finding)를 공유하기 전.

choices: Mom asked me to sets the table.
The coach ordered the players moving faster.
The man told his son to turn off the lights.
Bob wants to practice me the piano.
The teacher didn't allow us talked during the test.
items.explain: ③ 「tell+목적어+to부정사」. ① to set ② to move ④ wants me to practice ⑤ allow us to talk.

items.box:
Reporter: Mr. Davis. Do you like your job ⓐ<u>as</u> a sports agent?
Mr. Davis: Yes. I love sports, and I enjoy everything about business. I think my job is perfect for me.
Reporter: Can you tell me more about your job?
Mr. Davis: When my clients have a new contract ⓑ<u>to sign</u>, I check it carefully. I do my best to make the contract ⓒ<u>fairly</u> for them. Also, I often receive phone calls from advertising companies. They want my clients ⓓ<u>in</u> their advertisements. Then, I try ⓔ<u>to get</u> the best deal for my clients.

items.explain: 「make+목적어+형용사」이므로 fair. ⓐ as(~로서), ⓑ 형용사적 용법, ⓔ try to ~.

box.title: < 보 기 >
lines: What does Mr. Davis do when his clients have a new contract to sign?

choices: He signs the contract for them.
He checks the contract carefully.
He calls advertising companies.
He asks the reporter for help.
He makes advertisements for them.
items.explain: 새 계약이 있을 때 신중하게 확인하고 공정하게 만들려고 최선을 다한다.

items.box:
I am a sports manager for a professional soccer team. I make sure everything goes well and help the team succeed. My job is to give the team the best chance to win. I hire great coaches, manage the office staff, talk to the media, and solve problems.
When I get to the training ground, I talk to the players first. I tell ⓐ<u>them</u> how well they are doing and encourage them. I make sure they feel confident and ready for the game. Next, I meet with the head coach to check that everything is on track. We have regular meetings to keep things running smoothly. In the afternoon, I watch the team train. Watching soccer games and seeing the players improve is one of the best parts of my job. I enjoy ____________(A)____________.

choices: The writer works for a professional soccer team.
The writer hires coaches and talks to the media.
The writer talks to the head coach before the players.
The writer has regular meetings with the head coach.
The writer watches the team train in the afternoon.
items.explain: 훈련장에 가면 선수들과 먼저 이야기하고, 그다음(Next)에 감독을 만난다.

choices: the coaches
the office staff
the media
the players
the problems
items.explain: 선수들에게 먼저 말을 걸고, 얼마나 잘하고 있는지 말해 주며 격려한다.

choices: playing soccer games by myself
seeing everyone work together as a team
solving problems in the office alone
hiring new players every week
running on the track with the coaches
items.explain: 팀이 함께 일하는 것을 보는 즐거움으로 글을 맺는다.

items.box:
(가) Are you worried about your digital footprint? Do you want to erase ⓐ<u>it</u>? If you do, visit Happy Digital Laundry. We can clean your online history. (A) Leave a message on our website, and we'll help you soon.
(나) Jihun, we checked your online records and ⓑ<u>found</u> the ad. (B) Then, we asked the ad company ⓒ<u>to delete</u> your information, and they did. (C) Sharing photos with your friends is always fun. (D) To protect your personal information, don't click on ads or links from unknown sources. (E) It can ⓓ<u>be</u> very dangerous. We hope ⓔ<u>hearing</u> from you again.

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 글의 흐름상 전체적인 내용과 어울리지 <u>않는</u> 것은?
items.explain: (C) 친구와 사진을 공유하는 것이 재미있다는 문장은 개인 정보 보호 안내와 어울리지 않는다.
hope는 to부정사를 목적어로 취한다 → to hear. ⓒ 「ask+목적어+to부정사」.

choices: What can Happy Digital Laundry do for you?
How can you ask Happy Digital Laundry for help?
What did Happy Digital Laundry ask the ad company to do?
How much does Happy Digital Laundry charge for the service?
What should you do to protect your personal information?
items.explain: 서비스 요금은 나오지 않는다.

items.box:
SPORTS NEWS: Wolves Beat Monsters!
There was a big basketball game between the Boston Wolves and the Miami Monsters. The game ___ⓐ___ at the Boston Sports Center on September 2. The Boston Wolves won the game by 10 points. Michael James played his best game of the season against the Monsters. His perfect play made his team and his fans ___ⓑ___. Everyone is looking forward to his next game.

items.explain: 경기가 '열렸다'는 수동태 was held / 「make+목적어+형용사」, 팀과 팬이 흥분한 감정이므로 excited.

choices: Mia: The game was a baseball game.
John: The Miami Monsters won the game by 10 points.
Jun: The game was held on September 2.
Jay: Michael James played for the Miami Monsters.
Gary: Michael James is going to retire after the game.
items.explain: 9월 2일 보스턴 스포츠 센터에서 열린 농구 경기이며, 울브즈가 10점 차로 이겼고 Michael James는 몬스터즈를 상대로 경기했다.
